entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.14.0: Drawings, a new Smooth for any part, simple AI connection, thread profiles
entry.content:
Added

  • A very basic and simple drawing of a part or an assembly: views, scale, dimensions, text, title block, pen and marker, PDF. The open drawing follows its part.
  • Smooth turns any STL into editable features: Revolves for a turned part, Extrudes of its steps for a plate, a bracket or a box — along the part's own direction, even when it is tilted. It runs on your computer and takes time — minutes for a simple part, an hour or more for a complex one: run it overnight, or use it on simple parts. A connected AI is there to speed this up too: it rebuilds the part by the same method, much faster.
  • Mesh Section draws each outline like a designer: sharp corners, lines, arcs, one smooth spline where the shape is free.
  • Connect AI: pick Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI from its arrow — one not installed yet is installed (Node.js too), connected and started in one go. Add to AI apps sets up Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Cursor and others.
  • Threads: DIN 405 round and DIN 513 buttress; Custom profiles — triangle, trapezoid, semicircle; cut into the surface or grow onto it; Save for the next part.
  • A start page with your recent files and their pictures; Return to Assembly on a part opened with Edit; Split ▸ Make Assembly.

Fixed

  • Extrude To a face of the part from a sketch on a work plane joins the part (it made a separate solid).
  • The drawing sheet no longer jumps while you dimension; the grounded part of an assembly is marked on the part itself.
